name: SVC_WO_LINKS
description: This table is used to store and represent the links between field service work orders using Oracle Field Service linking feature.  WO_LINK_ID is primary / unique key in this table.

columns.name: WO_LINK_ID
columns.description: An autogenerated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: LINK_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: The foreign key that maps this record to the SVC_WO_TEMPLATES_B(LINK_TEMPLATE_ID)  table.

columns.name: LINK_TYPE_DIRECTION_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the direction of the activity in link template, such as LINK_FOR_FIRST, LINK_FOR_SECOND, LINK_FOR_SECOND,LINK_FOR_BOTH.

columns.name: FIRST_WO_ID
columns.description: The foreign key that maps this record to the SVC_WORK_ORDERS(WO_ID) table.

columns.name: SECOND_WO_ID
columns.description: The foreign key that maps this record to the SVC_WORK_ORDERS(WO_ID) table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: FS_SECOND_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Property used to indicate the activity id of the second Activity in OFS.

columns.name: FS_FIRST_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Property used to indicate the activity id of the first Activity in OFS.

columns.name: MAX_INTERVAL_VAL
columns.description: Property used to indicate the maximumm time interval between activities.

columns.name: MIN_INTERVAL_VAL
columns.description: Property used to indicate the minimum time interval between activities.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_SOURCE_CD
columns.description: Source code that indicates how the work order was last updated such as ORA_SVC_REDWOOD_AGENT_UI or ORA_SVC_OFSC or ORA_SVC_API.
